key=/root/.secure-volume.key

  printf '%s\n' 'Refusing to overwrite an existing secure-volume artifact' >&2
  exit 1
fi
sudo -n install -d -m 0700 /var/lib
sudo -n fallocate -l 1G "$backing"
sudo -n chmod 0600 "$backing"
sudo -n dd if=/dev/urandom of="$key" bs=64 count=1 status=none
sudo -n chmod 0400 "$key"
sudo -n /usr/sbin/cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --type luks1 --key-file "$key" "$backing"
